evidence.title: POLCA: Power Oversubscription in LLM Cloud Providers / Characterizing Power Management Opportunities for LLMs in the Cloud
evidence.read_scope: full relevant sections 2.2-2.3 and 3.2; production table 2
evidence.hardware: DGX A100 40/80GB; production cluster hardware not fully disclosed
evidence.supports: Interactive inference cluster power has diurnal variation; prompt and token phases have different power; allocation does not determine activity
evidence.boundary: Qualitative mechanism only; A100 power coefficients and 79% cluster peak are not transferred numerically to H100

evidence.title: Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
evidence.read_scope: section III characterization, figures 8-9 and table IV
evidence.hardware: DGX H100 and DGX A100; BLOOM-176B and Llama-70B
evidence.supports: Prefill power increases with batch size; decode power is less sensitive to batch; H100 decode power capping from 700W to 350W has little latency impact
evidence.boundary: 350-700W motivates broad SXM endpoint sensitivity; 525W central endpoint is a scenario interpolation, not a measured fit; PCIe ratio transfer is unvalidated

evidence.title: DynamoLLM: Designing LLM Inference Clusters for Performance and Energy Efficiency
evidence.read_scope: sections II, III.A-B and V.D-E; tables II-IV
evidence.hardware: NVIDIA DGX H100; vLLM; multiple open-source LLMs
evidence.supports: Input/output lengths, batching, load, frequency and parallelism affect energy; coding and conversation have different daily/weekly load profiles
evidence.boundary: Published full-production peak/valley values are not substituted for measured public-file statistics; adaptive GPU shutdown/frequency control is not assumed

evidence.title: The Model Parking Tax: Quantifying the Hidden Energy Cost of Always-On GPU Model Deployment
evidence.hardware: H100 80GB SXM5, TDP 700W; controlled experiment plus 14-GPU production telemetry
evidence.supports: Controlled H100 bare idle 71.8W, CUDA-context idle 121.7W; production CUDA-active idle mean 145.5W
evidence.boundary: 120W central online resident idle is a rounded experimental anchor; 100-160W is engineering sensitivity, not a confidence interval; 50-80W PCIe is TDP-ratio transfer

alpha.status: assumed average dynamic contribution of input tokens; no absolute GPU-seconds/token calibration

mean_allocated_ratio.source: PR34 frozen power-parameters.csv, inherited PR-v2 MIT V100 P50/TDP
mean_allocated_ratio.status: cross-generation, cross-workload annual energy anchor; not H100 measured mean

mapping.CPU: v3 host-CPU engineering proxy 0.25*combined allocated fraction retained
